about: Conditions: states applied to a creature for a while (or until removed). damage is periodic damage of damageType each tick of its clock; skip means the creature cannot act. Permanent properties are traits, not conditions.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: Poison works through the body, hurting a little at a time until it is cured.

warded.name: Warded
warded.description: A ward turns aside part of each blow.

blessed.name: Blessed
blessed.description: Blows land harder for a while.

weakened.name: Weakened
weakened.description: Blows land softer until the weakness passes or is treated.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.description: A wound that keeps bleeding until it is bound.

source.notes: Exact 50% fire resistance. How long it lasts is set by the ability or item that applies it.

wayfarer_guard.name: Wayfarer's guard
wayfarer_guard.description: Veyra watches over the traveller: saves come easier.
